title: Left sidebar reorder: layout first + auto-expand on multiple images
description: Reordered left sidebar so Layout section appears above Image Library (prevents overflow when many images loaded). Added auto-expand behavior: Layout section automatically expands when user adds more than one image, drawing attention to layout options.

files_changed.change: Fixed global drop handler: replaced direct layoutManager.regenerate() + _scheduleRender() with this._regenerateAndRender() so auto-expand fires on drag-drop
Reordered leftSidebarSections array: layout first, library second
Added autoExpandLayoutOnImages() method that expands layout section when images.length > 1
Added guarded call to vm.autoExpandLayoutOnImages() in _regenerateAndRender()
Updated 3.1.8 for new order; added 3.1.13 (expand when >1), 3.1.14 (no expand when <=1), 3.1.15 (no expand when 0)
Updated leftSidebarSections order assertion to match new layout-first order

test_results: All tests pass. 1 pre-existing failure in SaliencyDebugOverlayTest.html (unrelated).
tdd_cycle: RED: Wrote 4 failing tests (order assertion + 3 auto-expand behaviors). GREEN: Reordered array, added autoExpandLayoutOnImages method, wired into _regenerateAndRender. REFACTOR: No refactoring needed — changes follow existing autoExpandCropOnSelect pattern.
notes:
Auto-expand fires via _regenerateAndRender which is called after every image load (file picker, drag-drop, paste). The method is idempotent — calling it when layout is already expanded or when images <= 1 has no effect. Guarded with 'if (vm.autoExpandLayoutOnImages)' for testability. This was one of the UX improvements flagged by world-review in session 008.

BUG FIX: Global drop handler in createCollageLifecycle.js was calling layoutManager.regenerate() + _scheduleRender() directly, bypassing _regenerateAndRender(). Fixed by replacing with this._regenerateAndRender() so both file picker and drag-drop paths trigger auto-expand.
